description: Plasawica, a ghost of a village girl cursed to dance forever, a pale translucent young woman in a long white linen dress with red embroidery and a wreath of flowers on her loose hair, wild mad eyes and a grinning mouth, spinning in a frenzied dance with her arms flung out and her skirt flaring, clear solid shapes, eerie and menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the figure alone, no background
